Name: Willy and Clint buy more items
Author: bananasalmon
Description:
[b][size=3]Introduction[/size][/b]
Willy will now buy anything fish related and beach related! Ideal for especially early game, when the small backpack is a struggle... Imagine you forage on the beach before starting your fishing day, and everything you found, you can sell to Willy: coral, clam, sea urchin, but also anchor, dried starfish, and nautilus shell, and so on... Then you go fishing, and you fish up seaweed, sea jelly, and maybe some fish of course, and you can again sell your entire inventory to Willy! Less struggle early game!

Another shop that could fix some inventory struggle? Clint of course! You will now be able to sell all artifacts to Clint, so you can safely have him open a 100 artifact troves while selling in the meantime.

[i][color=#00ff00]Added in 0.4: Marlon! He will buy all your bombs, your monster musk, bone fragments, and more.[/color][/i]

[b]BIG UPDATE version 0.9 (summary)[/b]
[color=#ff7700]Five new shops added!!![/color]
[color=#ff7700]Pierre will buy back all cooking ingredients, tapper items, and (blue) grass starter[/color]
[color=#ff7700]Robin will buy back all building ingredients[/color]
[color=#ff7700]Harvey will buy back all medicines, potions and ginger items[/color]
[color=#ff7700]Sandy will buy back all desert items like fish, forage and fossils[/color]
[color=#ff7700]Pierre will buy everything he normally buys, plus the newly added items, [/color][b][color=#ff7700]during the Egg Festival!!![/color]

UPDATE 1.0 (summary)[/b]
[color=#ffff00]All Pierre's festival shops added[/color]
[color=#ffff00]Dwarf and Volcano Dwarf added, buying resources found in the mines[/color]
[color=#ffff00]Gus (Saloon and IslandResort) added, buying food, drinks and cooking ingredients[/color]

[b][size=3]Options[/size][/b]
Can be installed anytime and will work immediately on the first in-game day!

There is the configuration option to turn off each of the shops' edits. There are three options grouped that sell the same: Dwarf and Volcanodwarf; Saloon and Island resort; and all Pierre's festival shops.

Turning the config back on will immediately add tags to the shop, but will need a restart to add the new custom tags to some miscellaneous items like pearls.

[size=3][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Changes to Willy's shop tested with SVE and Eli & Dylan, so it is safe to assume that any mod that adds items properly with the right item tag will be added to the items Willy buys from you!

Changes to Clint's shop also tested with SVE. Works by the same item tag logic as Willy's shop. Just that the tag is tied to the item category.

Changes to Marlon's shop tested with SBV. [s]Unfortunately their potions don't have item tags.[/s] If you play with Sunberry Village 1.1.0 or higher you can sell potions! Please let me know if you have tested it with S&S, I have not progressed far enough in that mod to know all the added items and item tags and don't want to look in their code for spoilers. I am pretty sure I am not playing with other mods with potions or bombs.

Changes to Pierre's shop tested with an SVE tapper item and with my trees mod (adds palm sugar as a tapper item).

Changes to Robin's shop not tested with any other mod. If there are mods that change building ingredients or add new buildings with unique ingredients, let me know!

Changes to Harvey's shop tested with SVE and SBV. Potions and healing items can be sold. To sell Sunberry Village potions you will need to play with Sunberry Village 1.1.0 or higher!

Changes to Sandy's shop tested with Cornucopia. Unfortunately they do not use desert tags for for example the date and the sugarcane. However I did include compatibility with my trees mod (link below).

Changes to Pierre's Festival stands tested with syrup items and vanilla items. Again I don't think Pierre buys more modded items thanks to this mod besides palm sugar from my trees mod.

Changes to (Volcano) Dwarf's shop not tested with any other mod, since they buy a couple tags that are also added to Clint/Marlon/Robin.

Changes to Gus' shops (saloon and island resort) tested with modded cooking items such as Cornucopia, SVE, Kalash.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21578]Willy Buys Back Your Rods[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33994]Clint Buys Your Weapons and Rings[/url]!

[size=3][b]Compatibility notes for mod authors
[/b][/size]If you add one of the vanilla tags mentioned below to your modded items, they will be sellable thanks to this mod.

However, if you don't like any of the vanilla tags for your modded item(s) but want them sellable to any shop mentioned below, feel free to use the newly introduced tags, 'willy_and_clint_buy_more_items_{{name}}'! In return I wouldn't mind a thank you. :-)

If you introduce new item tags with your mod and want items sellable to a certain shop, feel free to look into my code, or reach out so I can add your tags in this mod.

In time I will add more vanilla tags to shops, and introduce more custom tags for the remaining shops. I am open to requests.
